settings.heading: No questions. Not one.
settings.text: If a formula is not right for your skin we collect it from your door and refund in full — even if the bottle is half empty. Skin is personal; a return is not a failure.

settings.title: Open the order
settings.text: Find it in your archive and choose Return. Tell us which pieces and, if you like, why.
settings.label: Within 60 days

settings.title: We book the courier
settings.text: A collection slot is offered for the next working day. No printer, no label, no queue.
settings.label: Same day

settings.title: Hand it over
settings.text: Reuse the original box or any box. The courier scans it at your door and that is your proof.
settings.label: At your door

settings.title: Refunded in full
settings.text: We release the refund the moment it is collected — not when it reaches us.
settings.label: 2–3 days to your bank

settings.yes_items:
